item.title: White Mailer Boxes
item.description: Clean, crisp, and impossible to ignore: the moment your customer pulls a perfectly constructed white box from their delivery bag, the brand impression is already forming. White communicates purity, precision, and intention. It is the palette that lets your logo own the moment without competition. White mailer boxes are built for brand owners who understand that the packaging is not secondary to the product. It is the opening act.
